shared_elements: glyph-like square blocks with rounded internal elements (in A's belt band and B's carved panel)
vertical central axis element flanked symmetrically
justification: Both surfaces show anthropomorphic imagery organised around a vertical axis, and A's belt band of repeated boxed motifs is loosely comparable to B's columns of square glyph-like blocks with rounded infill, but this is a generic correspondence. A is a full symmetrical scene of two elaborately costumed figures with discs, headdresses, sandals and a central mask-topped panel, whereas B is essentially a column of repeated rectangular sign-blocks with at most a small figural element, so the compositions, relationships and rendering conventions barely overlap.
